title: Implement and test wordCount helper
acceptance_criterion: wordCount returns the number of whitespace-separated words, returns zero for empty or whitespace-only input, and rejects non-string input with TypeError.
deterministic_validity_check: node --input-type=module -e "import { wordCount } from './src/wordCount.js'; if (wordCount('one two three') !== 3 || wordCount('  one\ttwo\nthree  ') !== 3 || wordCount('   ') !== 0 || wordCount('') !== 0) throw new Error('wordCount behavior failed'); try { wordCount(null); throw new Error('missing TypeError') } catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error }"
patch_requirements: Create src/wordCount.js with no imports from other helpers.
Create test/wordCount.test.js covering normal, whitespace-separated, empty, whitespace-only, and non-string TypeError cases.
